The narrator has a strong aversion to gambling.

Her arrival caused shock and confusion among the General's family and acquaintances.
The General was visibly rattled by the Grandmother's unexpected arrival.
The elderly woman is known as the Grandmother.
She won 4,200 gülden at the casino after betting on zero.
Her total winnings reached 12,000 gülden after betting on red.
She was registered as "Madame la générale, Princesse de Tarassevitcheva."
